_schema: ae operator ad-creative map (Phase 5, plan §4.6 / Q13). Example, not seeded data.
_description: One entry per ad the operator can map from UTMs to the promise the landing page must keep. Feed for ae_src_ad_creative until the meta/google/tiktok API connectors land (Phase 9); ingest maps these rows with provenance 'operator_map'.

_fields.campaign_id: campaign slug as the operator names it
_fields.utm_content: utm_content the ad's links carry (per-ad discriminator)
_fields.offer_text: the offer as the ad states it
_fields.claim_text: the claim the landing page must support
_fields.has_code: 1 when the offer needs a discount code
_fields.offer_led: 1 when the ad leads with the offer rather than the product
_fields.creator: creator handle for UGC ads, empty otherwise
